**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 satisfies the preferred WARRANTY position on every material term:

- **Services standard (19.1):** professional and workmanlike, qualified personnel, industry standards, plus material conformity to documentation and specifications.
- **Duration (19.2):** 90 days for Deliverables measured from delivery *or acceptance, whichever is later*; hosted Services warranted for the entire subscription term — better than the preferred 12-month software period.
- **Additional warranties (19.3):** no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution, no contaminating open source.
- **Remedy (19.4):** prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Disclaimer (19.5):** limited to implied warranties and expressly carves out express warranties, service levels, indemnities and remedies, so it does not swallow the express warranty.
